pages.text: The Docking Station is a multi-block structure that automatically forms when placed. It creates a 7-block gantry crane that straddles the rail or canal, allowing vehicles to dock and transfer resources.

pages.title: Docking Station
pages.text: Place beside a rail or canal. The structure automatically forms a flipped-U crane. The port face (front) exposes item, fluid, and energy capabilities for pipes and hoppers. Right-click to cycle redstone hold mode. Sneak+scroll to adjust idle timeout.
